what: Mueller Industries makes copper tube and fittings for plumbing and air conditioning, brass rod, and a range of industrial valves and components.
customers: Plumbing and HVAC wholesalers, equipment makers, and industrial manufacturers.
money: copper tube, fittings and line sets
valves and components for refrigeration and HVAC
moat: Copper mills close to customers in a business where freight costs make distant competition uneconomic, and where domestic capacity has been consolidating for decades.
risks: Copper prices drive both revenue and margin, and they are volatile
Demand follows housing and non-residential construction
Only two analysts cover the stock, so there is little independent scrutiny
opportunities: 13.7 times earnings with an 18.3% net margin, exceptional for a metals processor
$1.4B of cash against $27.5M of debt: the balance sheet is close to debt free
Revenue grew from $3.4B to $4.2B in two years and free cash flow is $690M
watch: Copper tube shipment volumes separate from metal prices.
